name: Che bap
summary: Chè bắp is a corn sweet soup of Cẩm Nam corn, rock sugar, and rich coconut milk. Hội An serves it as its own plate, though the dish did not start there.
origin: Served in Hội An, with corn from Cẩm Nam. The dish did not originate there.
texture: Cẩm Nam corn is evenly yellow, soft, and chewy.
taste: The light sweetness of rock sugar, the corn, and rich coconut milk.
howToEat: Order a bowl of the corn, the rock sugar, and the coconut milk.
The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article also names chè bắp beside chè đậu xanh and chè hạt sen, and says each bowl is fragrant with coconut milk.
where: Hội An, using corn from Cẩm Nam.
seoTitle: Che bap — corn sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Chè bắp in Hội An is Cẩm Nam corn, rock sugar, and rich coconut milk. The dish did not start there.
